composite.description: A struct tag is flat text, so any rendering of an object would be the generator's invention rather than something the schema said, and a consumer would have to guess the encoding back. Refused, with a warning.

backtick.description: A backtick would terminate the raw string literal the tag list is emitted inside — a compile error in the generated file, not a mangled tag, so there is nothing sensible to escape it to.
